verdict.rationale: Skyvern's browser-sessions docs describe a VNC stream that lets you "watch or take control at any point." They also document human-in-the-loop pauses that preserve browser state, and the same page lists "watch or take control of a running browser" as a feature. That directly covers live viewing and mid-run human takeover. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of live takeover, and documentation of how the agent resumes after a human intervenes on a stuck step.
